tasks.title: Add fetch_program_session_series() service + SessionSeriesResponse schema
tasks.notes: fetch_program_session_series(db, program_id, member_id, range_value): when member_id is None, SELECT date, SUM(session_time_seconds) FROM session_series WHERE program_id=:pid AND date>=:range_start GROUP BY date (cross-member SUM, D-01) -- never member_id IS NULL. When member_id is provided, add AND member_id=:member_id to the same shape. Zero-pad to num_days entries oldest-to-newest (mirror _zero_padded_points from program_detail_token_trend.py, adapted field names). period_total_seconds = sum of query totals; avg_seconds_per_day = round(period_total_seconds / num_days), fixed range day-count divisor (D-04). No filter on org_id (D-03) or program_roster/removed_at (C-4) anywhere in the query. Docstring notes the org-wide view is a cross-member aggregate, not a null-member_id read (Documentation requirements) and the session_series freshness dependency on BED-03's rebuild_program_rollups() (R-1).

tasks.title: Register GET /api/overview/program-detail/{program_id}/session-time-series on the overview router
tasks.notes: Eighth sibling route. range: str = Depends(_range_with_default); member_id: str | None = Query(None). Calls await program_visibility(current_user, program_id) once (open-aggregate veto). When member_id is not None, calls await member_in_program_visibility(current_user, program_id, member_id) BEFORE fetch_program_session_series is invoked (FR-6, mirrors PGD-05's /team/{member_id}/usage call order exactly) -- a 403 here means zero session_series queries run. No program_summary existence lookup, no 404 (matches token-trend/commands/team, not releases). Emits one program_drilldown structured log (method, path, program_id, range, status, latency_ms) via time.perf_counter() on the 200 path only, mirroring program_team_fetched/program_commands_fetched.
